facts.fact: 西德妮的卧室是姐姐照原样复刻的：花纹被子、床头的书、她一个月前写在镜子上的字都在。
facts.anchor: Credit to her sister, the room looked exactly as it had

facts.fact: 她原以为姐姐会比当初弱，结果姐姐把塞雷娜·克拉克造得像神一样。
facts.anchor: Instead, she’d made Serena Clarke a god.

facts.fact: 枕间塞着一只毛绒动物，脖子上围着她住院时姐姐带来的那条紫围巾。
facts.anchor: A stuffed animal sat tucked among the pillows, a purple scarf

facts.fact: 她想到不必让姐姐撤掉幻觉，也许只要让她把幻觉挪个位置。
facts.anchor: So maybe she didn’t need Serena to drop the illusion.

facts.fact: 她看见塞雷娜晃了一下，脖子上插着一支红色飞镖。
facts.anchor: Saw Serena sway, a red dart jutting from her neck.

facts.fact: 小屋外那个陌生人凭空出现。
facts.anchor: Saw the stranger—the same one from outside the cabin—step out of thin air

facts.fact: 塞雷娜倒下，梦也跟着塌了下来。
facts.anchor: Serena collapsed, and as she did, so did the dream

facts.fact: 她回到废弃公园里那间昏暗的棚屋，站在二层平台上。
facts.anchor: Into the darkened shack in the abandoned park.
